source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: For an **ASTRA MILITARUM** [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), **OFFICER** models may issue Orders. Use each **OFFICER**’s datasheet for its Orders per [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) and eligible recipients. For each Order choose one eligible friendly unit up to 6″ from the issuer. Your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) is the normal window for Orders. In any phase when an **OFFICER** exits a TRANSPORT or arrives on the battlefield, they may also give Orders as that phase ends. An Order runs until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) starts. Unless a rule specifies otherwise, a unit keeps only one Order and a later Order supersedes the earlier one. [Battle-shock](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) stops both issuing an Order to that unit and any Order already affecting it. Only **ASTRA MILITARUM** units can benefit. **MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!** adds 3″ Move. **FIX BAYONETS!** improves melee Weapon Skill by 1. **TAKE AIM!** improves ranged Ballistic Skill by 1. The **FIRST RANK, FIRE!** **SECOND RANK, FIRE!** Order increases the Attacks of [Rapid Fire](vsdata:weapon-ability/rapid-fire) weapons by 1. **TAKE COVER!** improves Save by 1 to a best of 3+. **DUTY AND HONOUR!** improves Leadership and Objective Control by 1.
